run_dummy_data_generation: run the smartwatch_gestures dummy data generator CLI to create sample gesture sensor data files
generate_dummy_data: generate dummy smartwatch gesture sensor data with random timestamps and accelerometer readings
create_dummy_file_path: create a dummy file path for a smartwatch gesture data file given participant, gesture, and attempt IDs
increment_time: increment a timestamp value at approximately 10Hz for either nano or milli time types
initialize_acceleration: initialize a random accelerometer value with a random sign and magnitude up to 13
